messages:
Ravi (Product): Quick async check for this quarter's OKR milestones — please post 1) shipped, 2) slipped, 3) blockers, 4) next steps + owner. Ping owners if not you.

Marta (Eng - Runtime): Shipped: runtime v2 canary completes on us-east yesterday (PR #4829 merged). Latency target met for 95p. Slipped: autoscaling policy integration (removed from canary). Blocker: metrics export bug causing some traces to drop. Next: hotfix + small rollback if regressions; owner @Marta.

Cheng (Eng - Platform): Shipped: model routing policy MVP finished (k/v store + policy DSL). Slipped: dashboard rollout (console) — needs paging UI. Blocker: frontend paging depends on design review. Next: Cheng to coordinate with Ava, timeline EOD Wed.

Ava (Design): Reviewed paging flows; left comments on figma. Can deliver mocks by Tue. Need product sign-off on two edge states.

Kevin (Eng - Infra): Shipped: node pool upgrade to G14 for dedicated. Slipped: on-prem packaging tests flaked. Blocker: flaky mount during docker build on certain hosts. Next: schedule infra test-run and move to hermetic images; owner Kevin.

Olivia (QA): Shipped: e2e for streaming + function calling. Slipped: regression suite for Private deployment (some flakes). Blocker: test infra timeout — investigating. Next: increase timeout and isolate failing test, owner Olivia; can use @Kevin help for infra.

Sam (Release): Release window for v2 GA aimed next Friday. Need canary to be stable 48h. Current canary started 12h ago. If no regressions, proceed. Ping @Marta and @Cheng for criteria.

Marta (Eng - Runtime): metrics bug repro steps:
```
curl -X POST https://internal-metrics.local/ingest -d '{"seq": ...}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'
# reproduces drop when payload > 64KB
```
Working on fix, PR by EOD.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for runtime v2 (canary id: can-2026-03-17-15). Health: OK (latency 92ms p95). Alerts: 0.

Nina (ML): Model quantization tests passed on canary variant q4-8bit. Noted minor quality delta on prompt set A (~1.2% BLEU drop) — recommend gate criteria relaxed <1.5% for that workload. Owner Nina.

Ravi (Product): Thanks all. Quick asks: 1) Marta/Cheng — can you both post a ✅ or ❌ by noon PT if canary okay for GA? 2) Sam — hold release until QA marks e2e stable 48h. 3) Ava/Product — finalize UX edge states before console deploy.

Kevin (Eng - Infra): ✅ node pool stable. Infra will run hermetic test tomorrow morning.

Marta (Eng - Runtime): ✅ will post PR link when merged; plan to monitor 24h.

Cheng (Eng - Platform): ❌ dashboard pagination not ready, so console rollouts should wait. Platform will gate on UX merge.

Olivia (QA): I'll tag the test run tomorrow 06:00 PT, will report pass/fail by 12:00 PT.

Sam (Release): Copy — release hold in place until QA green and canary 48h.

Ava (Design): Pinged Ravi for sign-off on two edge states, expecting response within 3 hours.

Ravi (Product): Great. If anything slips, update this thread. Thanks — will summarize in the OKR doc after EOD.
